In GSE, the HNSW index bypass causes O(n) complexity in vector retrieval, leading to delayed or incorrect contextual grounding. Simultaneously, hardcoded fallbacks in the cognitive router mask real-time signals, introducing systematic bias. These failures propagate into GSI’s Bayesian inference engine, where stale or biased inputs corrupt posterior distributions. The root cause lies in the lack of a unified temporal freshness gate across modules. The system must enforce a strict 'green light' protocol before any prediction is published, ensuring that all inputs are validated against the latest injury load and model version. This requires a mechanical predicate-based quarantine mechanism in `public.picks` to prevent stale or future-dated picks from entering the live board. The retroactive audit ledger ensures reversibility and traceability of all changes.
